decisions.rationale: "Myotonic dystrophy" in the title names one specific disease with no further subdivision in this text, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate §4 (duplicate mentions)

decisions.rationale: The second occurrence of "Myotonic dystrophy" in the abstract's first sentence is the same specific disease and is annotated again as a duplicate mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §4 (duplicate mentions); What to Annotate §1 (Specific Disease)

decisions.rationale: "DM" is the abbreviation defined in "Myotonic dystrophy ( DM )" and refers to the same specific disease, so it is a separate synonymous mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §6 (synonymous mentions, abbreviation separated)

decisions.rationale: "neuromuscular disorder" describes a family of multiple specific neuromuscular diseases rather than one defined disease, so it is a Disease Class.
In "the DM gene" the token DM is the gene symbol for the locus, not a disease mention, so it is not annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (only disease mentions are annotated); What NOT to Annotate §1 (non-disease referents)

decisions.rationale: "disease" is a very general term with no specific disease identity in this context and is excluded.
"congenital form" refers to a particular defined form of myotonic dystrophy (congenital DM), analogous to a particular-form mention like classical galactosemia, so it is a Specific Disease.
In "various DM tissues" the disease abbreviation DM modifies the noun "tissues", so it is annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §3 (disease mentions used as Modifiers)

decisions.rationale: In "418 DM patients" the disease abbreviation DM modifies the noun "patients", so it is annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §3 (disease mentions used as Modifiers)

decisions.rationale: The second occurrence of "congenital form" refers to the same particular form of myotonic dystrophy and is annotated as a Specific Disease.
